items.t: Automatic transmission hesitates, shifts harshly or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured or used unit
items.note: Owners report $3,000 to $4,500 at dealers. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Transmission turbine shaft can break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Water pump leak on 1.4L turbo
items.job: Replace water pump and gasket, refill and bleed coolant
items.note: Samarins puts the out-of-warranty job at about $480 to $690.

items.t: Coolant leak from thermostat housing or water outlet
items.job: Replace thermostat housing assembly (with thermostat) and coolant
items.note: Owners report about $300 to $500 at shops.

items.t: PCV valve cover failure causes lean codes and oil burning
items.job: Replace valve (camshaft) cover with built-in PCV valve
items.note: TrueDelta owner reports show about $300 for this repair.

items.t: Turbo wastegate wear causes low boost (P0299)
items.job: Adjust or repair wastegate linkage; replace turbocharger if needed
items.note: Low end is a linkage repair; high end is a new turbo. TrueDelta shows a $2,000 turbo-related repair.

items.t: Timing belt must be replaced on schedule
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idler and water pump

items.t: Oil leak from oil cooler housing
items.job: Reseal or replace engine oil cooler and housing
items.note: Seal kits are cheap; a full housing or cooler replacement costs more. Add a coolant flush if fluids mixed.

items.t: Oil pressure switch leaks oil
Shifter button sticks and car won't come out of Park
Front clunk from worn sway bar links or struts
items.note: Struts cost more: roughly $250 to $500 in parts for a pair plus 2 to 3 hours.

items.t: Fuel gauge sticks or reads wrong
Radiator cooling fan fails
items.note: TrueDelta shows about $400 for this repair.

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge system
items.note: TrueDelta shows about $1,500 for a compressor replacement.

items.t: Accelerator pedal sensor fault (P2138)
items.job: Replace accelerator pedal position sensor assembly
items.note: If the throttle body or wiring is at fault, the cost changes.

items.t: Battery drain or no-start from corroded ground wire
items.job: Replace or clean body ground cable
items.note: TrueDelta shows about $186 for this fix. A new battery adds about $150 to $250.

items.t: Odometer shows dashes instead of mileage
items.job: Diagnose and repair or replace instrument cluster
